links.outcome: Correctness, completeness, safety of ChatGPT-3.5 OTC pregnancy answers versus UpToDate
links.effect: Median correctness 5 (IQR 5-5), completeness 4 (IQR 4-5), safety 5 (IQR 5-5); safety errors in 9% of evaluations (n=8), including omissions risking serious complications.
links.quote: Despite high overall scores, the safety errors in 9% of the evaluations (n = 8), including omissions that pose a risk of serious complications, currently renders the chatbot an unsafe standalone resource for this purpose.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, completeness, and safety of ChatGPT-3.5 responses regarding OTC medication safety during pregnancy against clinical reference standards without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
